template_inputs.label: Loan / shareholder / director / current-account funding pending classification

template_inputs.label: Fixed assets and accumulated depreciation
template_inputs.method_a: Asset opening or Opening Entry to Fixed Asset + Accumulated Depreciation

template_inputs.label: Tax / VAT / payroll liabilities only where accountant-approved
template_inputs.method_a: Opening Entry to accountant-approved tax/payroll liability accounts. Do not invent VAT/payroll truth

template_inputs.label: Retained earnings / equity / opening-balance treatment

template_inputs.label: Foreign-currency balances and translation / revaluation inputs
